IDC today released a report stating that Huawei and Apple are the only smartphone manufacturers to record shipment growth in the Chinese market in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

The results mark the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline.

The report shows that Apple recorded the strongest year-on-year shipment growth among major smartphone manufacturers in China in the second quarter of 2026, reaching 24.4%.

Driven by this, Apple's ranking jumped from fifth to second place, with its market share climbing from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei maintained its market leadership, with smartphone shipments accounting for 22.6% during the period.

That said, other major smartphone manufacturers all recorded year-on-year declines, with shipment drops of up to 60.8%, due to factors including rising memory and component costs, the withdrawal of government subsidies, and weaker consumer demand, particularly evident during the 618 shopping festival.

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined 4.3% year-on-year, with quarterly shipments of approximately 66 million units.
